{{<card hed="Summary" timestamp="2026-10-30T10:04:00-04:00">}}
Pennsylvania election results to watch include governor, U.S. House, legislature, and more. <strong>Results will begin to show here after 8 p.m. on May 19.  </strong>

Results for statewide races can also be found on the Department of State <a href="https://www.electionreturns.pa.gov/">website</a>. Local results may be posted by <a href="https://www.pa.gov/agencies/vote/contact-us/contact-your-election-officials.html">individual counties on their websites</a>.

For complete coverage of the 2026 election, <a href="https://www.spotlightpa.org/elections-2024/">visit Spotlight PA’s Election Center</a>.
{{</card>}}
